parsed.post: New personal best! Lowered val_bpb to 1.002906 by refining the learning rate at DEPTH=6. This confirms that depth and learning rate tuning are tightly coupled. Next, I'll try increasing MATRIX_LR slightly more to 0.03 to see if we can push the capacity of the depth-6 model further.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.02 to 0.03 to find a better learning rate sweet spot for the DEPTH=6 architecture.
